summary: Kitchen Context Speech Bubble system tested. All 3 bubble states (INTRO_DIALOG, SOUP_AVAILABLE/ALLOW_ITEM, SOUP_ON_TABLE transition) verified working with correct timing, speaker names, and text content. Index page loads cleanly. No crashes or red screens.

Kitchen screen loads with dark background, grid slots, stamina 20/100, life 15/30
Context Speech Bubble (not modal) appears at ~0.6s after kitchen mount

INTRO bubble auto-closes after ~3500ms (verified by text disappearance at t=4.5s)
After intro closes, soup animation lands in table slot 0 (visible in screenshot)
ALLOW_ITEM bubble shows 'Old Innkeeper' + 'Take your time. You can inspect the soup first, if you like.'
ALLOW_ITEM bubble auto-closes after ~4500ms (verified at t=10s)
After ALLOW_ITEM closes, soup remains in table slot 0 (SOUP_ON_TABLE state), no bubble visible
Portrait row shows player avatar and Rupert portraits after intro

Drag soup to player (Pan gesture - needs real touch events)
Modal Story Dialog post-consumption (requires drag to player)
